ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum positive; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 84.52. Not an investment buy yet. What would upgrade it: weekly momentum turning up, a reclaim of the investor-cycle low, or the first daily cycle right-translating — add on confirmation, not ahead of it.

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 12 · failed · daily cycle day 39).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): unconfirmed turn. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 84.52. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 84.52 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 39 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: inside the typical low-timing window — a dip is more likely from here, though the trend can keep running
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 39 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 处于典型的低点时间窗口内——从此处回调概率更高，但趋势仍可能延续
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量为正；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；上一周期左移（见顶偏早））。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 84.52 下方。暂非投资性买入。何种情形会升级：周线动量转为向上、收复投资者周期低点、或首个日线周期呈右移结构——在确认之后加仓，而非提前。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_knife_line: ⚠ Deep washout — price is 23% below its 200-day, a broken primary trend. Measured: setups this stretched below the 200-day held the cycle low only ~37% of the time and drew a ~−22% tail (violent bounces, rarely the durable low). Treat as knife-risk — wait for it to reclaim the 10-day average and size small. The score above is already tempered for this.
ladder.bc_knife_line_zh: ⚠ 深度超卖——价格较 200 日均线低约 23%（主趋势已破）。实测：如此远低于 200 日线的形态，仅约 37% 守住周期低点，且回撤尾部约 −22%（反弹猛烈，但很少是持久低点）。视为「接飞刀」风险——等其收复 10 日均线后再小仓参与。上方分数已据此打折。

entry_signal.action: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 84.52. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.20 ± 0.22 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLK) reads duration-neutral (-0.06). Inflation-neutral.

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 下行 · 较200日均线 -23% · 逆势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Minor accounting flags — keep an eye on them.

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

squeeze.label: Vol squeeze
squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -9% · 极端 -29% · → 建议仓位 25%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
